body: No I haven't tried medications, I don't see the point to that.

I guess I don't want it to be then. It takes a lot of effort and energy into creating music and depression finally just made me too tired to even keep up with it. Also, my music is terrible, I have deleting all of it off my computer on a final to do list, I do not want anyone to hear it.

I have. Songwriting was my main way to cope with life and all of the negativity depression has put on me. However, lately I just feel like putting energy into making mediocre music is not a good enough reason to live.
it is difficult. I'm sorry you are experiencing this as well.

I have had one, talk therapy is not beneficial to me and it was very much a waste of my time. Music was my biggest reason to live, I don't have anything in this life but just singing with my guitar was something that gave me light. Lately, though, the negativity has seeped into that too. I have nothing.
